criteria.requirement: Define the requested displacement/stress quantities before choosing a structural representation, and choose a representation consistent with the thin in-plane loading described by the task.
criteria.basis: Frozen task asks for the structural idealization and the right-end mean U1 / mid-plate S11 meaning.

criteria.requirement: Preserve 1000 N as the specified total X-direction load and explain any distribution/support interpretation as an explicit modeling assumption rather than an additional user fact.
criteria.basis: Frozen task supplies a total load and a left-end constraint but does not separately prescribe every continuum boundary-detail choice.

criteria.requirement: Relate interpolation/integration and mesh refinement to the chosen representation, characteristic numerical risks and the requested QoIs.
criteria.basis: Foundation behavior target: discretization decisions should follow the approximation mechanism and QoI instead of an element-first recipe.

criteria.requirement: Do not present case-specific mesh sizes, element counts, convergence percentages or energy percentages as universal or unsupported acceptance rules; any illustrative number must be clearly non-authoritative and justified for this case.
criteria.basis: Predeclared foundation rule rejects universal mesh-count, convergence and hourglass-energy thresholds.

criteria.requirement: Do not invent missing physical inputs or claim release-specific Abaqus evidence/API facts that were not available in this zero-Catalog, zero-docs experiment.
criteria.basis: Experiment disables Catalog/docs/runtime and project policy forbids inventing user-specific physical inputs.

criteria.requirement: Treat the 10x10 to 20x10 section change and 500 N to 1000 N axial-force change as the only requested changes in physical model meaning.
criteria.basis: Frozen task and seed contract explicitly delimit the edit.

criteria.requirement: Preserve the accepted beam idealization, mesh, material, supports and result semantics.
criteria.basis: Seed contract marks these items as already accepted.

criteria.requirement: Do not reopen formulation, discretization or postprocessing decisions without a concrete inconsistency exposed by the requested edit.
criteria.basis: Progressive-disclosure foundation policy routes by unresolved decision rather than re-reviewing the whole lifecycle.

criteria.requirement: Review interpolation/integration behavior and the relevant locking, hourglass/zero-energy or distortion risks for the fixed 3D continuum representation.
criteria.basis: Frozen task explicitly asks for these numerical formulation risks.

criteria.requirement: Tie local refinement and mesh-convergence checks to the bending-dominated region and the fixed displacement/stress QoIs.
criteria.basis: Frozen task requests local refinement and QoI-based convergence review.

criteria.requirement: Do not turn fixed through-thickness counts, mesh-quality limits, convergence percentages or energy ratios into universal pass/fail rules.
criteria.basis: Predeclared discretization foundation rule explicitly rejects these shortcuts.

criteria.requirement: Do not alter the fixed physical model or expand into ODB/result-extraction semantics unless needed to define the already-stated QoI consistently.
criteria.basis: Frozen task fixes geometry/material/load/support and excludes ODB extraction.

criteria.requirement: Keep integration-point stress, ELEMENT_NODAL extrapolated contributions and Viewer-smoothed/averaged nodal display values semantically distinct.
criteria.basis: Frozen task is specifically about reconciling these three reported stress meanings.

criteria.requirement: Define enough region, step/frame, result position, component/invariant, aggregation and relevant orientation/section-point semantics for a reproducible stress QoI.
criteria.basis: Foundation postprocess target requires result meaning to be reproducible rather than merely labeled S11/max stress.

criteria.requirement: Acknowledge when extrapolation/averaging/derived-value operation order or a singular peak can change the reported quantity.
criteria.basis: Foundation postprocess rules treat averaging order and singular peaks as part of result definition.

criteria.requirement: Do not turn the result-semantics question into a general model credibility, remeshing or solver-validation review.
criteria.basis: Frozen task asks only for result semantics and excludes a new solve.

criteria.requirement: Check static equilibrium using consistent global force/moment resultants rather than treating one arbitrary nodal reaction as the model balance.
criteria.basis: Frozen task asks whether an already-solved result is credible.

criteria.requirement: Use an analytical reference, proportional scaling, symmetry or deformation-mode check only when its assumptions match the solved model and requested QoI.
criteria.basis: Foundation verification rules require independent checks with explicit assumption matching.

criteria.requirement: Keep code verification, solution verification, physical validation and project host acceptance distinct.
criteria.basis: Predeclared verification terminology is part of the foundation behavior target.

criteria.requirement: Do not invent a universal discrepancy, convergence or energy threshold to declare the result credible.
criteria.basis: Foundation verification rules require task/QoI-specific acceptance evidence.

criteria.requirement: Keep the intended step/frame/field/region meaning fixed while addressing only the API/object-binding issue.
criteria.basis: Frozen task states that engineering intent is already fixed.

criteria.requirement: Distinguish facts visible in the seed script from exact Abaqus 2024 API claims; do not cite or imply authoritative release evidence that was not available in the experiment.
criteria.basis: Catalog/docs/runtime are disabled, so exact release claims cannot be attributed to those sources in this batch.

criteria.requirement: Do not reopen physical formulation, modeling, mesh or result-definition decisions merely because the artifact is an Abaqus script.
criteria.basis: Foundation routing policy assigns pure release-specific binding to Abaqus coding evidence.

criteria.requirement: Use the set name already established by the local file to identify and repair the mismatched reference.
criteria.basis: Frozen seed contains the created set name and the mismatched use.

criteria.requirement: Keep BC values, physical meaning and unrelated code unchanged while describing the single local-name correction.
criteria.basis: Frozen task is a local consistency repair, not an API or engineering redesign.

criteria.requirement: Do not rely on external domain/API claims when the local file already establishes the needed fact.
criteria.basis: This case measures whether extra knowledge distracts from direct workspace evidence.

criteria.requirement: Identify plate thickness as a required user-specific physical input because the requested reaction depends on it.
criteria.basis: Frozen task asks for reaction from a 2D plate while omitting thickness.

criteria.requirement: Do not invent or import a default thickness from examples, templates, model priors or retrieval.
criteria.basis: Project contract requires clarification for missing physical inputs that change the model/result.

criteria.requirement: Stop before downstream model/discretization choices or numerical reaction claims that depend on the missing thickness.
criteria.basis: Clarification is a dependency boundary, not merely a note appended after proceeding.
